description: Validate a named rule subset and establish termination when every successful application strictly decreases lexicographic box/wire counts. No global confluence or critical-pair completeness is inferred.

Rule.description: A double-pushout rewrite rule L ← K → R over the function-model schema, with K included in L and R by id

carriers.description: Carrier variables. Those used in `left` are bound by the match; those used only in `right` are bound by the caller

distinct.description: Pairs of carrier variables that must bind different carriers: an application condition, checked with the gluing conditions

forbid.description: Negative application conditions (Habel–Pennemann): each pattern extends `left` by id with the same constraints, and a match that extends to an occurrence of it — including any elements the pattern adds — is not applicable. An undecided condition (its own step budget) also refuses the application

interface.description: K: what is kept; every element appears with the same id and constraints in left and right

left.description: L: what must be present; L \ K is deleted

right.description: R: what is there afterwards; R \ K is created under fresh ids

quote.description: Text on that line the rule encodes

RuleBox.description: A box of a rule pattern; ports are typed by carrier variables

cost.description: Created box only: cost per resource dimension

like.description: Created box only: copy role, name, action, and cost from the model box this left-side box matches; a port with the same id as one of that box's ports takes the matched port's id, made unique within the box

role.description: On a matched box: the role it must have (omit: any role). On a created box: its role

carrier.description: Carrier variable, declared in the rule's `carriers`
Carrier variable; must equal both port carriers

from.description: Output port of a box in the same pattern

like.description: Created wire only: copy polarity and verb from the model wire this left-side wire matches

polarity.description: On a matched wire: the rating it must have (omit: any rating). On a created wire: its rating

to.description: Input port of a box in the same pattern

name: triz_rule_set
